summary: The chat went almost silent this week: 8 messages total and Lauren sent exactly one word ("Yes", approving a $400 custom). After a month of being the most engaged voice in the room - uploading content same-day, adding Snap fans within hours, running a strategy call - she has effectively stopped talking. Ollie posted the customs sheet on Aug 11 asking for 3 customs ASAP (including one aimed at winning back a lapsed diamond fan) and got no reply, then chased again on Aug 13 with "Lauren Not sure if you saw this" - still nothing. Meanwhile every open item from last week rolled over untouched: Derrek's promised Meta ad-stats call (promised Aug 3) never happened, no written confirmation that chatter pricing/scripts were fixed to her boundaries (raised Aug 1), no phone-farm/IG rollout updates Derrek promised would start the week of Aug 3, and no whale-reactivation follow-up after she personally messaged all her top spenders on Aug 7. The one thing that ran on time was Michelle's weekly leak-removal report. Her next invoice lands Aug 15 with the 5% paid-ads line item still unsupported by any ad report - that is the flashpoint.
